d:
Israel’s election has sparked a political controversy after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party accused Arab parties of election fraud and stealing votes. However, Israeli police said they had found no evidence to substantiate claims of widespread election fraud.
Meanwhile, four more people were arrested in an alleged election bribery scheme linked to the Ra’am party. The case follows the earlier arrest of three people suspected of planning to pay voters in exchange for votes. Ra’am has denied the allegations.
Video Editor: Rahul
